verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical scaled-down copies of the square layout, not real rearrangements. Both carry over the original's flaw of the subtitle sitting almost on top of the CTA pill, and both leave the decorative circle sitting behind 'Light'. A has an awkward ~90px dead gap between the headline and the subtitle, which makes the text block look scattered. B groups headline, subtitle and CTA more tightly and brings the product closer to the headline, but it pushes the badge and logo down, leaves a large empty band at the bottom (~100px) and still keeps the cramped subtitle/CTA spacing.
